name: apify
description: Use this skill when the user asks to find, inspect, or run Apify Actors or Tasks, scrape a website or platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Maps, Google Search, Reddit, Amazon, Airbnb, and similar), retrieve items from an Apify dataset, read an Apify key-value store record, or check the status of an Apify Actor run. Pick it for web scraping, data extraction, lead generation, and running Apify automations. Do not use it for building or deploying your own Actor source code.
human_description: Scrape any website, and any platform for useful business data.
